headline: Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand Ignite Along Shifting Fronts
war_summary: Since the midday wire, fighting has surged into Marban Hollow, where seven rapid base turnovers across the last two hours at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall have carved the region into three Warden garrisons, four Colonial footholds, and a contested ruin. Kuura Strand's earlier stability dissolved under four swift exchanges over Talven and Faden Point, reducing one strongpoint to unoccupied rubble. Active fighting has also spread to Mooring County, where The Wind Hills changed hands twice amid heavy butcher bills, while Briar in the Stlican Shelf saw fresh turnover under accelerating losses. Linn of Mercy and the Weathered Expanse continue their protracted melees, logging further transitions at Outwich Ranch, Lathair, and Crow's Nest as casualties mount on both sides. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line remain ferocious cauldrons of attrition, absorbing thousands of fallen soldiers without a single parapet yielding ground.
